## 📖 Added definitions (glossary backfill)

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| AGI | AGI refers to the 16th International Conference on Artificial General Intelligence where this paper was presented, a venue for research on general-purpose cognitive systems. |
| MDP | MDP is the standard mathematical framework for sequential decision-making used to model the reinforcement learning tasks, defined by states, actions, rewards, transition probabilities, and a discount factor. |
| TD | TD refers to the temporal-difference error used in the Q-Learning update, representing the difference between estimated and target Q-values. |
| PPO | PPO is a modern deep reinforcement learning algorithm mentioned as a stronger baseline that was not included in the comparison, highlighting a limitation of the study. |
| DQN | DQN is a deep reinforcement learning algorithm mentioned as a stronger baseline that was not included in the comparison, highlighting a limitation of the study. |
| CI | CI refers to confidence intervals, a statistical measure not reported in the paper's results, which is noted as a missing quantitative element. |
| CLI | CLI is the command-line interface used in the provided scripts to pass arguments like random seeds, ensuring deterministic and reproducible runs. |
